note: METHOD: three background scripts through scripts/chamber/fetch_throttled.py: MusicBrainz artist search (six composers per request, then work?artist=&inc=recording-rels for plausible non-namesake artists), Deezer album and artist search on the full or short name, and Apple composerTerm song search for all 161 composers (all answered; FetchError: 0 composers). Hits were opened through MusicBrainz release lookups, Deezer album pages (the track lists of all 288 albums issued under a composer's own full name were compared with the candidate titles), the New World Records page and the IMSLP work info (all 587 pages read through api.php: uploader, publisher, first performance, audio entries); 7 WebSearch calls and one 404 WebFetch. RESULT: 570 of the 587 pages are recent uploads (not-public-domain); 17 works of 9 composers are kept, 570 pages skipped. KEPT ON A COMMERCIAL RECORDING: Nichifor (String Quartet No. 1, Electrecord LP 1980, Gaudeamus Quartet; Klezmer Dance, Alpha Classics 2024), Keyhani (both quartets, Arqanoon Records 2014), McKay (Three Monologues, NeoQuartet on her own Gavia Music label; premiered by the S.E.M. Ensemble quartet), Milburn (Menil Antiphons, New World NWCR736), Moreno Sabio (Comme des brouillards silencieux, Liquen Records 2022; Septetino cósmico, Tañidos 2015), Masotti (Skyriana, Preludio Srl 2014), Letort (Baltika, Minsk, Blues comme l'enfer: album 'East', Cube Quartet, on his own label Musicube 2013; electronics may be involved, the scores are string quartets). KEPT AT LOW CONFIDENCE ON IMSLP'S OWN EVIDENCE (the owner may drop them): Lohse's Haiku, Istid, Koncert and Smoke (premieres by Ensemble Nordlys at Danish Radio and the Black Diamond; a 2001 studio recording of Smoke per a Wikiversity page; no commercial release found) and Marín García's String Quartet (the IMSLP audio entry cites CGC Producciones CDCT 0304 and the Ensemble Solistas de Sevilla quartet; nothing else found). MATCHING CALLS: Keyhani's String Quartet No. 2 is matched to the album track 'To Her Beautiful Eyes (For String Quartet)' by IMSLP's alternative title 'For Her Beautiful Eyes' and the Yerevan recording (album notes date it fall 2010, IMSLP 2011; year entered 2011). 'And His Cuff Was Damped with Tears' is written for Persian instruments (2 kamancheh, 2 gheychak) and entered as a string quartet as IMSLP does. Nichifor's Anamorphose rests on MusicBrainz release data (the LP's track list was not opened); his Klezmer Dance page is the clarinet-violin-piano version (the recorded one). Masotti's performers' instruments are not stated. Levels are estimates: no score was opened for any kept work. Dates left blank where not confirmed (McKay, Milburn, Marín García, Masotti). PROPOSED FOR EXCLUSION: 128 composers whose pages are self-uploads by an individual account, with nothing found on MusicBrainz, Deezer or Apple; several have only their own streaming releases or computer mock-ups (Liu Zhouyuan's 'String Quartet No. 1' and 'No. 2' are on Deezer under his own name as label, Leira Carnero, Mantione, Orefice G. P., Ottavini, Mishchenkov, Mandelberg's 'Sweet Suites'). Leira Carnero also has a violin-catalogue entry (Carnavalito XXI, two violins), which stays. NOT PROPOSED, but nothing passes (skipped as not performed or recorded): 24 composers with a Wikipedia article, an independent recording of other music, a named publisher or a claimed professional premiere: Kan-no, Kolp, Malmgren, Manookian, Mansurov, Mourey, Kosviner, Militello, Kirschner, Joachim, Krähenbühl, Kristinkov, Klaes, Mekaev, Lundgren, Lawton, Klimek, Malancioiu, Mandozzi, Ness, Kondo, Kirsch, Körner, Nikmaram. OPEN PROBLEMS: weak 'none found' for common names (matched on given name and surname): Jacobs, Joachim, Johnston, Jones, Kelly, Kim, Latham, Lawrence, Li, Lin, Lin, Little, Locke, Lopes, Lowe, Lyons, Marando, Marquis, Martín Díaz, Martinez, Matyas, McIntyre, McLean, Miguel, Mills, Mondry, Moore, Morris, Mota, Munoz, Navarro, Ng, Ngo, Nichols, Nicholson, Norton, Nuñez, Oh, Orton, Pacheco. The Apple composerTerm search returned a composer-field hit only for Nichifor. No page was judged out of scope; the viol-consort pages (Klaes, Nazaykinskaya) are in scope but unrecorded.
